clusters.name: After the birth of Bea, 1995–1996
clusters.reason: Within about a year and a half after the birth of your sister Bea in March 1995, several things piled up: your mother grew worn out and on edge, your father started working late and staying distant from her, you began having stomach aches and missing school, your father and brother fell into shouting matches, and your mother did not go back to her job; this run of shifts across the family around the new baby's arrival looks like one period, settling afterward since nothing more is recorded until 2003.
